mu_name_from: MODEL_PLATINA_STAFF (MODEL_STAFF + 13), loaded from Item/CW_Staff.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1105). Ours is named Staff14 by the index-plus-one rule; MU never loads a Staff14 file. Group 5 number 13 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:255.
why_this_one: The 100-140 weapons MU has and this game lacked (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's); the first four, one a class, lowest first.

stats.call_note: The Season 6 CreateWeapon: group, number, slot, skill, width, height, dropsFromMonsters, name, dropLevel, minimumDamage, maximumDamage, attackSpeed, durability, magicPower, levelRequirement, strength, agility, energy, vitality, then darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel.
